sn45.122-126:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yamunā nadī samuddaninnā samuddapoṇā samuddapabbhārā.
sn45.122-126:1.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave aciravatī nadī samuddaninnā samuddapoṇā samuddapabbhārā.
sn45.122-126:1.5: seyyathāpi bhikkhave sarabhū nadī samuddaninnā samuddapoṇā samuddapabbhārā.
sn45.122-126:1.7: seyyathāpi bhikkhave mahī nadī samuddaninnā samuddapoṇā samuddapabbhārā.
sn45.122-126:1.9: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yā kācimā mahānadiyo. seyyathīdaṃ.
sn45.122-126:1.10: gaṅgā yamunā aciravatī sarabhū mahī sabbā tā samuddaninnā samuddapoṇā samuddapabbhārā.
sn45.122-126:1.11: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro.
sn45.122-126:1.12: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronato nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro.
sn45.122-126:1.13: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti amatogadhaṃ amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ. pe. sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti amatogadhaṃ amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ.
sn45.122-126:1.14: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāroti.
